title: Gustavo Petro Talks with Sheinbaum About the “New Political Reality” of the Americas
author: La Redacción
content:
_This article by[La
Redacción](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/la%20redacci%C3%B3n) originally
appeared in the [September 2, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/02/politica/gustavo-petro-
visito-a-la-presidenta-sheinbaum-en-palacio-nacional), Mexico's premier left
wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Colombia's former president, Gustavo Petro, visited Mexican
head of state Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo on Wednesday.

During his visit with President Sheinbaum, Petro **warned about the risks of
interference from the United States in Latin American electoral processes**.

The Colombian, who is on a visit to Mexico, maintained that Mexico must watch
what happens in the region's electoral processes, such as in Brazil, as well
as the advance of right-wing forces, ahead of **Mexico 's 2027 midterm
elections and the 2030 presidential election**.

“I have just come from speaking with the president of the United Mexican
States, @Claudiashein,” he posted on his X account, alongside a photograph
from Mexico City's Zócalo.

After meeting with the Mexican head of state, Petro said they talked about
what he considered “a new political reality in the region,” linked to
operations originating outside the countries where the elections are held.

> The current issue is the new artificial political reality. We could call it
> that based on all these investigations that have been carried out from
> Bolivia and that cover all of the Americas, because its real center is in
> Washington, its financing is in Israel.
>
> Gustavo Petro

The former Colombian president has been on a visit to Mexico since Monday and
on Wednesday is giving a keynote lecture at UNAM.

On leaving the National Palace he commented that Sheinbaum Pardo **invited him
to stay in Mexico** to carry out academic activities.

“She invited me to some intellectual and academic collaborations that I would
not mind doing, but I decided to live in Colombia,” he said.

### Petro Shares Photo with Sheinbaum

That evening, Colombia's former president posted on his X account a photo with
the head of state and the message “With the president of Mexico
@Claudiashein.”
